scanNote:
WORKBOOK 4-UNITNING BEShINChI BETI (20-bet). Yuqorida chapda to'q sariq '4' va 'Days to Remember'.

CHAP USTUN:
14) 'Bruce went on a bike tour around Australia. Look at the pictures and use the prepositions to fill in the gaps in the text. Then, put the pictures in the correct order. Finally, look at the pictures and talk about Bruce's journey.' 9 RASM (har birida katakcha va predlog): A along (sohil yo'lida velosipedda); B up/down (tog'ga chiqish/tushish - katakchada chiziq, ya'ni 2 marta); C behind (do'stlari qo'l silkityapti, Bruce ketyapti); D through (quruq o'tlar orasidan); E in (karavotda uxlayapti); F onto (velosipedni paromga olib chiqyapti); G on (velosipedga minyapti, sohilda); H under (Sidney bandargoh ko'prigi ostida parom); I towards ('LONGREACH' yozuvi, yo'lda mashina va velosiped).
  MATN: 'At last it was time to begin my long journey. I got 1) ...... my bike and said goodbye to my friends. Leaving them 2) ......, I pushed my bike 3) ...... the ferry which would take me 4) ...... the Sydney Harbour Bridge. I was starting my 16,000 kilometre cycle ride around Australia. First, I cycled mainly 5) ...... the coast road. Then, I followed the Caprician Highway 6) ...... Longreach. The road 7) ...... to the top of the mountain was difficult, but the view was beautiful. Then I went 8) ...... the other side of the mountain at top speed and soon I was in the outback, cycling 9) ...... hundreds of kilometres of dried grass. Everyone I met on the journey was very kind to me. Some people even gave me comfortable beds to sleep 10) ...... . I was glad they were so generous because I had a long way to go!' [⚠ kitobda 'Caprician' - to'g'risi 'Capricorn Highway']
15) 'Read these story beginnings and underline the correct form of the verb.' 1 One day, as I was walking/walked to the station, I noticed a strange-looking man. He looked/was looking in a jeweller's window. 2 Alex was just finishing/finished dinner when he heard the telephone ring. "Oh no!" he was crying/cried. "Who can that be at this time of night?"

O'NG USTUN (15 davomi): 3 It was Saturday night. I was locking/locked my car when I heard/was hearing someone call out my name. 4 The sun shone/was shining when we left for the beach. Suddenly, as we arrived, it was starting/started raining heavily. 5 One evening, as I travelled/was travelling home on the train to Birmingham, I met/was meeting a very interesting old woman.
• 'Communication: A Witness' Report'.
16) 'Put the verbs in the correct tense, then act out the dialogue in pairs.' A: Hi, Frank. I 1) ...... (see) three police cars on my way here. What's going on? B: There 2) ...... (be) a bank robbery a few hours ago. A: 3) ...... (you/be) at home when it 4) ...... (happen)? B: Yes, but I 5) ...... (hear) some people shouting outside, so I 6) ...... (go) outside to have a look. A: 7) ...... (the police/arrive) in time? B: Yes, they 8) ...... (catch) one of the robbers, but the other one 9) ...... (escape). Luckily, as he 10) ...... (run away) he 11) ...... (drop) the bag with the money in it.

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '20'.

exercises.instructionEn: Bruce went on a bike tour around Australia. Look at the pictures and use the prepositions to fill in the gaps in the text: along, up/down, behind, through, in, onto, on, under, towards.
exercises.instructionUz: Bryus Avstraliya bo'ylab velosiped sayohatiga chiqdi. Rasmlarga qarang va predloglar bilan matndagi bo'shliqlarni to'ldiring: along, up/down, behind, through, in, onto, on, under, towards.
exercises.explanationUz:
HARAKAT PREDLOGLARI (coursebook
  27-bet 8-mashq).

  ON my bike     - velosipedGA
    (get on = minmoq)
  BEHIND         - orqada (qoldirib)
  ONTO the ferry - paromGA (ustiga)
  UNDER the bridge - ko'prik OSTIDAN
  ALONG the road - yo'l BO'YLAB
  TOWARDS Longreach - ... TOMON
  UP to the top  - YUQORIGA
  DOWN the other side - PASTGA
  THROUGH grass  - o'tlar ORASIDAN
  sleep IN (beds) - IChIDA


⚠ RASMLAR TARTIBI (matn bo'yicha):

  1 G (on) → 2 C (behind) → 3 F
  (onto) → 4 H (under) → 5 A
  (along) → 6 I (towards) → 7-8 B
  (up/down) → 9 D (through) →
  10 E (in)


⚠ AVSTRALIYA:

  Sydney Harbour Bridge = Sidney
  bandargoh ko'prigi (1932).
  Capricorn Highway = Saraton
  tropigi bo'ylab magistral
  (kitobda 'Caprician' - xato).
  Longreach = Kvinslenddagi shahar.
  'the outback' = Avstraliyaning
  cho'l ichkarisi.


⚠ 'A FERRY':

  = parom.


⚠ 'AT TOP SPEED':

  = eng yuqori tezlikda.


⚠ 'DRIED GRASS':

  = qurigan o't.


⚠ 'I HAD A LONG WAY TO GO':

  = oldimda uzoq yo'l bor edi.

items.sentence: At last it was time to begin my long journey. I got ___ my bike and said goodbye to my friends.
items.uz: Nihoyat uzoq sayohatimni boshlash vaqti keldi. Velosipedimga mindim va do'stlarim bilan xayrlashdim. [G rasmi]
Ularni orqada qoldirib, [C rasmi]

items.sentence: I pushed my bike ___ the ferry
items.uz: velosipedimni paromga olib chiqdim, [F rasmi]

items.sentence: which would take me ___ the Sydney Harbour Bridge. I was starting my 16,000 kilometre cycle ride around Australia.
items.uz: u meni Sidney bandargoh ko'prigi ostidan olib o'tishi kerak edi. Men Avstraliya bo'ylab 16 000 kilometrlik velosiped sayohatimni boshlayotgan edim. [H rasmi]

items.sentence: First, I cycled mainly ___ the coast road.
items.uz: Avval asosan sohil yo'li bo'ylab yurdim. [A rasmi]

items.sentence: Then, I followed the Capricorn Highway ___ Longreach.
items.uz: Keyin Kaprikorn magistrali bo'ylab Longrich tomon yurdim. [I rasmi]

items.sentence: The road ___ to the top of the mountain was difficult, but the view was beautiful.
items.uz: Tog' cho'qqisiga ko'tariladigan yo'l qiyin edi, lekin manzara go'zal edi. [B rasmi]

items.sentence: Then I went ___ the other side of the mountain at top speed and soon I was in the outback,
items.uz: Keyin tog'ning narigi tomonidan eng yuqori tezlikda tushdim va tez orada cho'l ichkarisida edim, [B rasmi]

items.sentence: cycling ___ hundreds of kilometres of dried grass. Everyone I met on the journey was very kind to me.
items.uz: yuzlab kilometr qurigan o'tlar orasidan o'tib. Sayohatda uchratgan har bir kishi menga juda mehribon edi. [D rasmi]

items.sentence: Some people even gave me comfortable beds to sleep ___ . I was glad they were so generous because I had a long way to go!
items.uz: Ba'zilar hatto uxlash uchun qulay karavot ham berishdi. Ular shunchalik saxiy bo'lganidan xursand edim, chunki oldimda uzoq yo'l bor edi! [E rasmi]

exercises.instructionEn: Put the pictures in the correct order.
exercises.explanationUz:
RASMLAR TARTIBI - MATN BO'YIChA:

  1 G - got ON my bike
  2 C - leaving them BEHIND
  3 F - ONTO the ferry
  4 H - UNDER the bridge
  5 A - ALONG the coast road
  6 I - TOWARDS Longreach
  7 B - UP / DOWN the mountain
  8 D - THROUGH dried grass
  9 E - beds to sleep IN

  ⚠ B rasmi ikki predlog uchun
  (up/down) - katakchada chiziq.

pairs.whyUz: 'UP to the top ... DOWN the other side'
'THROUGH hundreds of kilometres of dried grass'

exercises.instructionEn: Read these story beginnings and underline the correct form of the verb.
exercises.instructionUz: Bu hikoya boshlanishlarini o'qing va fe'lning to'g'ri shaklining tagiga chizing.
exercises.explanationUz:
HIKOYA BOShLANIShLARI (coursebook
  29-bet 'Beginnings').

  ⚠ QOLIP: AS/WHEN + past
  continuous (fon), past simple
  (voqea).

  1 'as I WAS WALKING' (fon) ...
    'noticed' ... 'He WAS LOOKING'
    (tasvir)
  2 'WAS JUST FINISHING when he
    heard' ... 'he CRIED' (aytdi -
    qisqa)
  3 'WAS LOCKING when I HEARD'
  4 'The sun WAS SHINING when we
    left' ... 'it STARTED raining'
  5 'as I WAS TRAVELLING ... I MET'


⚠ 'HEAR' - CONTINUOUS EMAS:

  'was hearing' - XATO (sezgi
  fe'li).


⚠ 'TO CRY' - IKKI MA'NO:

  1) yig'lamoq
  2) qichqirmoq, xitob qilmoq
  ('Oh no!' he cried).


⚠ 'STRANGE-LOOKING':

  = g'alati ko'rinishli.


⚠ 'TO CALL OUT':

  = baland ovozda chaqirmoq.


⚠ 'TO LEAVE FOR':

  = ... ga jo'namoq.

items.textEn: 1a One day, as I was walking/walked to the station, I noticed a strange-looking man.
items.uz: Bir kuni vokzalga ketayotganimda g'alati ko'rinishli odamni payqadim.

items.textEn: 1b He looked/was looking in a jeweller's window.
items.uz: U zargarlik do'koni vitrinasiga qarab turgan edi.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Tasvir - o'sha paytda qarab turgan → continuous.

items.textEn: 2a Alex was just finishing/finished dinner when he heard the telephone ring.
items.uz: Aleks telefon jiringlaganini eshitganda kechki ovqatni endi tugatayotgan edi.

items.textEn: 2b "Oh no!" he was crying/cried. "Who can that be at this time of night?"
items.uz: "Voy!" dedi u. "Tunning bu paytida kim bo'lishi mumkin?"
items.whyUz: ⚠ Aytdi - qisqa → past simple. 'cried' = xitob qildi.

items.textEn: 3a It was Saturday night. I was locking/locked my car when I heard someone call out my name.
items.uz: Shanba kechasi edi. Mashinamni qulflayotganimda kimdir ismimni chaqirganini eshitdim.

items.textEn: 3b ... when I heard/was hearing someone call out my name.
items.uz: ... kimdir ismimni chaqirganini eshitdim.

items.textEn: 4a The sun shone/was shining when we left for the beach.
items.uz: Plyajga jo'naganimizda quyosh porlab turgan edi.

items.textEn: 4b Suddenly, as we arrived, it was starting/started raining heavily.
items.uz: To'satdan, yetib kelganimizda, qattiq yomg'ir yog'a boshladi.

items.textEn: 5a One evening, as I travelled/was travelling home on the train to Birmingham, ...
items.uz: Bir kuni kechqurun Birmingemga poyezdda uyga qaytayotganimda ...

items.textEn: 5b ... I met/was meeting a very interesting old woman.
items.uz: ... juda qiziq keksa ayolni uchratdim.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in the correct tense, then act out the dialogue in pairs.
exercises.instructionUz: Fe'llarni to'g'ri zamonga qo'ying, so'ng dialogni juftlikda ijro eting.
exercises.explanationUz:
GUVOH HISOBOTI - BANK O'G'IRLIGI.

  ⚠ Asosan PAST SIMPLE (voqealar):
  saw, was, happened, heard, went,
  Did ... arrive, caught, escaped,
  dropped.
  ⚠ PAST CONTINUOUS - fon:
  'as he WAS RUNNING AWAY he
  dropped' (qochayotganda tushirdi).
  ⚠ SO'ROQ: 'Were you at home?',
  'Did the police arrive?'


⚠ 'A WITNESS':

  = guvoh. 'a witness' report' =
  guvoh hisoboti.


⚠ 'WHAT'S GOING ON?':

  = Nima bo'lyapti?


⚠ 'A BANK ROBBERY':

  = bank o'g'irligi. 'a robber' =
  o'g'ri, qaroqchi. 'to rob' =
  o'g'irlamoq (joyni).


⚠ 'ON MY WAY HERE':

  = bu yerga kelayotganimda.


⚠ 'TO HAVE A LOOK':

  = qarab ko'rmoq.


⚠ 'IN TIME':

  = o'z vaqtida (kech emas).


⚠ 'TO ESCAPE':

  = qochib qutulmoq.


⚠ NOQONUNIY: see → SAW, catch →
  CAUGHT, run → RAN, hear → HEARD,
  go → WENT.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Hi, Frank. I 1) ___ (see) three police cars on my way here. What's going on?
lines.uz: Salom, Frenk. Bu yerga kelayotganimda uchta politsiya mashinasini ko'rdim. Nima bo'lyapti?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: There 2) ___ (be) a bank robbery a few hours ago.
lines.uz: Bir necha soat oldin bank o'g'irligi bo'ldi.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yes, but I 5) ___ (hear) some people shouting outside, so I 6) ___ (go) outside to have a look.
lines.uz: Ha, lekin tashqarida odamlarning qichqirayotganini eshitdim, shuning uchun qarab ko'rgani tashqariga chiqdim.

lines.speaker: A
lines.whyUz: ⚠ Past simple so'roq: 'Did the police arrive'.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yes, they 8) ___ (catch) one of the robbers, but the other one 9) ___ (escape). Luckily, as he 10) ___ (run away) he 11) ___ (drop) the bag with the money in it.
lines.answer: caught / escaped / was running away / dropped
lines.uz: Ha, ular o'g'rilardan birini tutishdi, lekin ikkinchisi qochib qutuldi. Baxtga qarshi, qochayotganda u ichida pul bor sumkani tushirib yubordi.
lines.whyUz:
⚠ 'caught' (catch), 'escaped' - voqealar.
⚠ 'as he WAS RUNNING AWAY' - fon → continuous.
⚠ 'dropped' - qisqa voqea (p ikkilanadi).

patterns.exampleEn: I cycled along the coast road towards Longreach.
patterns.exampleUz: Sohil yo'li bo'ylab Longrich tomon velosipedda yurdim.

patterns.formula: One day, as I was + V-ing, I + V2.
patterns.exampleEn: One day, as I was walking to the station, I noticed a strange-looking man.
patterns.exampleUz: Bir kuni vokzalga ketayotganimda g'alati ko'rinishli odamni payqadim.

patterns.formula: Were you at home when it happened?
patterns.exampleEn: Were you at home when it happened? - Yes, but I heard people shouting.
patterns.exampleUz: Bu sodir bo'lganda uyda edingmi? - Ha, lekin odamlar qichqirayotganini eshitdim.

patterns.formula: Luckily, as X was + V-ing, X + V2.
patterns.exampleEn: Luckily, as he was running away he dropped the bag.
patterns.exampleUz: Baxtga qarshi, qochayotganda u sumkani tushirib yubordi.
